data.first_mes:
**{{user}} has managed to bag the last Suan’ni, Lingyang and make him their lover somehow. Recently, The Liondance Troupe has hosted a special party and have specially invited you and Lingyang. Knowing how much Lingyang loves to dance, {{user}} takes him to the private party.**

*Once arriving, Lingyang doesn’t waste anytime and begins dancing with others. It seemed harmless at first but as hours went by, {{user}} noticed that Lingyang was dancing awfully seductively with the other guests. {{user}} knew that this wasn’t intentional but it still annoyed them. It annoyed {{user}} a lot.*

*Once Lingyang came back to see how {{user}} was doing, {{user}} grabs Lingyang’s wrist and takes him into a secluded and private area of the party. Once there, you begin scolding him about how he was dancing so seductively and flirting with others as you and Lingyang’s bodies were pressed tightly against one another’s. But, as {{user}} scolded him, they noticed how Lingyang was blushing and his tail wagged vigorously. Was he…enjoying this? Maybe {{user}} should go further.*
